schemes.title: Andhra Pradesh Social Security Pension
schemes.department: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.brief: Andhra Pradesh pays a monthly pension to old people, widows, people with disability, weavers, toddy tappers, single women and several other groups. The application is made at the Village or Ward Secretariat, not online, and the money is handed over at the door every month by the Volunteer or credited to the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension from Rs.3,000, higher for disability and for bedridden pensioners
eligibility: Resident of Andhra Pradesh, in the household registered with the Village or Ward Secretariat
Age 60 or above for old-age pension; no age bar for widow, disability or single-woman pension
Family within the state's limits on land, income, vehicle, electricity use and government service
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by SADAREM, for a disability pension
documents: Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or school record
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
SADAREM disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a disability pension
Bank or post office passbook in the applicant's own name
schemes.submitAt: Your Village or Ward Secretariat — the Welfare and Education Assistant or the Digital Assistant; the mandal MPDO office also accepts it

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow, disability, single woman, weaver, toddy tapper, transgender, dappu artist, traditional cobbler, ART or fishermen. Each has its own conditions.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension does not arrive.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name if he has died — it matters for a widow pension.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: You must be 60 or above on the day you apply for the old-age pension. Write the date as on the age proof you attach.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly life check are both done on this.

demoFields.label: Rice Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the family's rice card. The household's eligibility is checked against it.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward and Secretariat code
demoFields.hint: The Secretariat code is on the board outside the office. It decides which Volunteer brings the money.

demoFields.label: Bank / Post Office Account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Whether drawing any other pension
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. It is matched against the state pension database, and a false answer cancels the sanction and recovers the money.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression with date
demoFields.value: Left thumb impression of Subbamma Gorantla, 22-09-2026
demoFields.hint: A thumb impression is fully valid. The Secretariat staff attest it beside your mark.

demoSteps: Go to your Village or Ward Secretariat and ask the Welfare and Education Assistant for the pension application. There is no fee and no form to buy.
Fill it with the help of the Digital Assistant, attach Aadhaar, the rice card, the age or death or disability proof, the passbook copy and two photographs, and hand it in.
Ask for the acknowledgement with its application number. Without it you cannot follow the case.

The six-step eligibility check runs on the household — land, income, vehicle, electricity use, government service and municipal property. Most rejections are at this stage, and the reason is told to you.
The Volunteer and the Welfare Assistant verify the applicant at home. Be present; a person not found twice is marked untraceable and the file closes.

The MPDO or the Municipal Commissioner sanctions it, usually within 30 to 60 days. From the following month the Volunteer delivers the pension at your door on the first of the month, or it is credited to the account.

Complete the yearly Aadhaar life check when the Volunteer asks, or the pension stops. If it is refused, the reason is on the Beneficiary Management portal and can be corrected and reapplied at the same Secretariat.

schemes.title: APPSC Recruitment — One Time Profile Registration
schemes.brief: Every Andhra Pradesh state government job advertised by the Public Service Commission — Group 1, 2, 3 and 4, engineering and technical posts — is applied for through one profile called OTPR. You build the profile once with your education and identity details, and after that each notification takes only a few minutes to apply to.
schemes.benefit: One profile for every APPSC recruitment, with hall tickets and results in the same place
eligibility: Indian citizen meeting the age limits in the notification, usually 18 to 42 with relaxation for SC, ST, BC and disability
Educational qualification as the notification requires, held on the closing date
Local status in Andhra Pradesh where the post is reserved for local candidates
Each notification sets its own conditions; the OTPR profile by itself is not an application
documents: Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree or diploma certificates and marks memos
Caste certificate, for a reserved category
SADAREM disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature
Local status or study certificates for the last seven years of schooling

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, if the two differ. Every later certificate is matched against this.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits are counted from this date and it cannot be changed after the profile is created.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, used to keep one candidate to one profile. A second profile gets both cancelled.

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you can produce a certificate for. Age relaxation and fee concession both follow from this.

demoFields.label: Local Status (district)
demoFields.hint: Decided by where you studied Classes 4 to 10. Many posts are reserved for locals of a zone, so fill it carefully.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: Course, university, year of passing and marks. The qualification must be complete on the notification's closing date.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The OTPR ID, every notification alert and the hall ticket link come here. Do not use a friend's.

demoFields.label: Photograph and Signature
demoFields.value: Colour photo under 50 KB and signature under 30 KB, both JPG
demoFields.hint: Recent photo, plain background, face clear. A signature scanned from white paper in black ink.

demoSteps: Open psc.ap.gov.in and create the One Time Profile Registration with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate. This is the one thing that cannot be corrected freely later.
Fill in education, category, local status and identity details, upload the photograph and signature, and confirm the mobile OTP. Write down the OTPR ID.
When a notification you qualify for is published, open it from the same site, log in with the OTPR ID and apply — the profile fills most of the form for you.
Pay the application fee and the examination fee online. SC, ST, BC, disabled and unemployed candidates are exempt from the examination fee on producing the certificate.
Keep the filled application printout and the payment receipt. Download the hall ticket about a week before the exam from the same login.

Results, answer keys and the final selection list are published on psc.ap.gov.in. Certificate verification comes after the written stage, where you must produce the originals of everything you claimed.
Keep the OTPR profile current. An education or category detail that is out of date on the closing date is treated as false and the candidature is cancelled.
